paragraphs: The father of R' Avdimi of Tzippori. Mentioned in Beitzah, chapter 1, halakhah 9; Rabbi Yitzchak son of Rabbi Elazar reported in his name.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Guggenheimer Beitzah 1:9 paragraph explicitly has Rabbi Imi, father of Rabbi Avdoma of Tzipporin, with Rabbi Yitzchak beRabbi Lazar reporting in his name. The full titles for Imi, Yitzchak and the father within beRabbi are locally written out. Hyman’s Avdimi/Elazar/Tzippori forms remain distinct from the digital Avdoma/Lazar/Tzipporin; R' is retained for the differently spelled Avdimi pointer. No new genealogy or teacher binding is admitted.
